title: TOWER TUMBLE (JENGA)
rules:
1. Eligibility: Exactly 1 participant per Higher Secondary School.
  2. Format: Single Elimination (Knockout). Players play 1 vs 1 in pairs. The loser of each match is eliminated; the winner advances to the next round.
  3. Final Round Exception: If more than 2 players reach the Final Round, all remaining finalists play together in a single match, taking turns one after another in a fixed order until only one remains.
  4. Structure: The tower consists of 18 levels with 3 wooden blocks per level (54 blocks total).
  5. Construction: The initial tower setup is done exclusively by the event coordinator before the match starts.
  6. Time Limit: A player has a maximum of 20 seconds to complete their move.
  7. Move Completion: A move is complete only after a block is successfully removed and placed on the top level.
  8. One-Hand Rule: Players must use only one hand to touch, pull, or place a block.
  9. Forbidden Levels: Players cannot pull or remove a block from the top unfinished level.
  10. Top Level Construction: A new level cannot be started until the current top level has a complete set of 3 blocks.
judging:
• Using Two Hands: Using both hands to touch, pull, steady, or adjust a block will invoke a penalty—your turn is skipped immediately.
  • Time Violation: Taking longer than 20 seconds to make and complete a move will invoke a penalty—your turn is skipped immediately.
  • Tower Collapse: If the tower falls during or as a result of your turn, you are eliminated from the game.
  • 1st Place Winner: The single last remaining player after all other competitors have been eliminated.
  • 2nd Place Runner-Up: The player who was eliminated immediately before the 1st Place winner.
